# Apibara Copart & IAAI Vehicle Auction API Examples

Official code examples for the Apibara Copart & IAAI Vehicle Auction API.

Product page: https://apibara.tech/en/products/vehicle-auction-data-api
Endpoints: https://apibara.tech/en/products/vehicle-auction-data-api/endpoints
Documentation: https://apibara.tech/en/products/vehicle-auction-data-api/docs
OpenAPI: https://apibara.tech/openapi/vehicle-auction-data-api.json

Base URL: https://apibara.tech/api/v1/vehicle-auction
Authentication: X-API-Key HTTP header.

Main endpoints:
- GET /vehicles
- GET /vehicles/{slugVin}
- GET /vehicles/{slugVin}/history
- GET /vehicles/{slugVin}/related
- GET /vehicles/filters
- GET /vehicles/{slugVin}/shipping
- GET /locations
- GET /shipping/auction-to-port
- GET /vehicles/urltodetails

Use cases:
- Copart and IAAI search websites
- Vehicle auction marketplaces
- VIN auction history tools
- Dealer inventory enrichment
- Automotive CRM systems
- Shipping price calculators
- Salvage car analytics dashboards
- WordPress vehicle auction listing websites
- AI vehicle data agents
